name: DOCEtaxel plus Prednisone (mCRPC)

biomarkers.note: Cytotoxic taxane chemotherapy is not biomarker-restricted. Castrate testosterone (below 50 ng/dL) must be maintained with ongoing ADT. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Prostate Cancer, Systemic Therapy for M1 CRPC (PROS-18) and Discussion.

lineOfTherapy: category 1 taxane chemotherapy option for docetaxel-naive metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer; preferred post-ARPI in patients without prior docetaxel exposure

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: docetaxel-naive metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (M1 CRPC), fit for taxane chemotherapy, on ongoing ADT
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v6.2026, Discussion, prostate lines 7415 to 7417 (docetaxel category 1 for docetaxel-naive mCRPC; preferred post-ARPI without prior docetaxel)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: ongoing ADT (orchiectomy, LHRH agonist, or LHRH antagonist)

drugs.name: DOCEtaxel

provenance.locator: Discussion, prostate line 7419 (the standard regimen is 75 mg/m2 every 3 weeks; a biweekly 50 mg/m2 alternative exists)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Prostate v6.2026 Discussion, prostate line 7419 (the standard regimen is 75 mg/m2 every 3 weeks). ISMP tall-man DOCEtaxel. 75 mg/m2 IV on day 1 of a 21-day cycle (TAX327). A biweekly alternative of 50 mg/m2 is source-stated (prostate line 7420) but not modeled here.

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Prostate v6.2026 Discussion, prostate line 7266 (prednisone 5 mg twice daily). Companion daily prednisone 5 mg PO twice daily continuously with docetaxel (TAX327). Represented as days 1 to 21 of the 21-day cycle (continuous).

supportiveCare: continue ADT to maintain castrate testosterone below 50 ng/dL (PROS-G).

guideline.locator: PROS-18 (Docetaxel category 1 for docetaxel-naive mCRPC), prostate line 1783; Discussion (docetaxel 75 mg/m2 every 3 weeks, prostate line 7419; prednisone 5 mg twice daily, prostate line 7266)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for DOCEtaxel plus prednisone in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (disease #54 mCRPC; TAX327). The docetaxel dose (75 mg/m2 IV every 3 weeks) is dose-grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Prostate v6.2026 Discussion (prostate line 7419), and the companion prednisone dose (5 mg PO twice daily) to prostate line 7266. cycleLengthDays 21 is source-stated; cycles is left null because the total cycle count is individualized and not fixed in the provided extract (treat to response/tolerance). Ongoing ADT to maintain castrate testosterone below 50 ng/dL is required (PROS-G). A biweekly 50 mg/m2 docetaxel alternative is source-noted but not modeled. No dose was invented or inferred. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
